workOrder.title: [PR173 independent TEST-DRAFT REVIEW acceptance only; no coding] local Node repair: Add formatClockD
workOrder.goal:
[PR173 independent TEST-DRAFT REVIEW acceptance only; no coding] local Node repair: Add formatClockDuration(seconds) to src/localBrain/examples/duration.js and export it alongside unchanged formatDuration. Return HH:MM:SS with two-digit minimum hours and exactly two-digit minutes/seconds; hours do not wrap at 24. Accept only nonnegative safe integer numbers and throw RangeError for every other input. Preserve the exact existing formatDuration behavior and all read-only files. Isolated candidate only; no deployment, cloud, website, background learning, installation or external dispatch.
Owner acceptance criteria:
1. One top-level acceptance test preserves the existing exact-decimal orderBoxes examples and validation assertions from the read-only examples.test.js; stock.js remains byte-identical.
2. One top-level acceptance test preserves every existing formatDuration valid and invalid assertion from the read-only examples.test.js, including MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and its export.
3. One top-level acceptance test exercises the new exported formatClockDuration: 0=00:00:00; 9=00:00:09; 59=00:00:59; 60=00:01:00; 3599=00:59:59; 3600=01:00:00; 86399=23:59:59; 86400=24:00:00; 360000=100:00:00; MAX_SAFE_INTEGER=2501999792983:36:31. Reject -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1, strings, null, undefined, booleans, objects, arrays and bigint with RangeError. Do not coerce or wrap hours.
Change every selected editable file only. Protected acceptance tests and read-only dependencies cannot change. No installation, network, API fallback or production access.
